states.label: Protected
states.treatment: The two gates settle into place, then stay still.
states.sourceMapping: A 0.6-second settle on entry follows the native protected transition.

states.label: Reconnecting
states.treatment: An offset wave moves through the two gates. The symbol keeps its shape.
states.sourceMapping: A 1.5-second opacity wave adapts the existing seven-tile reconnect animation. “Loading” can share this motion only while connection or setup is actually pending.

states.label: Paused
states.treatment: Quiet gates and a small pause sign keep the state recognizable without motion.
states.sourceMapping: The native paused state dims its tiles to 40% and outlines its door. Switch keeps the dimming and proposes two small pause bars.

states.label: Needs attention
states.treatment: One gate carries a slow amber pulse; a small marker remains when motion stops.
states.sourceMapping: A 1.8-second pulse follows native attention timing. The proposed marker replaces the displaced native corner tile; shape and text accompany color.

states.label: Managed
states.summary: Settings are managed by your team.
states.treatment: A gate bar joins the two halves. Clear ownership, without an alert.
states.sourceMapping: The native managed state adds a gate bar across its door. Switch carries that bar through the central opening.

states.label: Signed out
states.treatment: The solid mark becomes an outline. Present, but not active.
states.sourceMapping: The native signed-out state outlines its tiles and door. Switch uses the same outline convention.

status: Selected geometry approved by owner; motion/state treatments proposed for implementation
